section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the findings of a study (referred to as 'the study' or 'present study') that aimed to validate the BAS-2 among adolescents and young adults in Denmark, Portugal, and Sweden. It confirms the single-factor structure and partial scalar invariance of BAS-2 across sexes and countries, supporting its cross-cultural use. The study also found consistent positive associations between body appreciation and self-esteem, psychological well-being, and intuitive eating, but observed varying relationships between BAS-2 and BMI across the three countries. Limitations regarding sample representativeness and size are also discussed.
